title: M3 hex standoff (IR v1)
prompt: Hex standoff for M3: 5.5 mm across the flats, 12 mm tall, with a 2.5 mm hole through the middle so I can tap an M3 thread into it.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
5.5 mm across flats, 6.35 mm across corners, 12 mm tall
Eight flat faces: six hex sides plus the two ends
One cylindrical bore through the middle
The bore is the 2.5 mm M3 tap drill

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t1-m3-hex-standoff: a polygon compound curve and a tapped hole (size M3 + thread: the tap drill 2.5 and a cosmetic M3×0.5 thread in the report).
